title: Head-position update
statement: Let $n$ and $p$ be natural numbers. For a head movement that stays in place, the updated position is $p$; for a rightward movement, it is $p$ when $p=n+1$ and otherwise $p+1$; for a leftward movement, it is the natural-number subtraction $p-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A movement sign: zero, positive, or negative
